data.name: Abroms
data.gender_notes: Abroms is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Abraham, meaning 'father of many'. In the Old Testament, Abraham is considered the father of the Jewish people. The name Abroms carries the meaning “Father of a multitude” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abroms usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a multitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes paternity, leadership, and a deep connection to one's heritage.
data.etymology: Abroms belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of a multitude.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abroms total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.long_meaning: Αβρόμ ονομασία με προέλευση από τα εβραϊκά και την ελληνική γλώσσα. Η σημασία του Αβρόμ είναι άμεση σχέση με το Θεό. Σημαίνει πνευματική ενίσχυση και ευλογία, με βάση την ανάλυση του ονόματος σε έβδομη και τρίτη. Η ονομασία Αβρόμ έχει ιστορική καταγραφή στην Πρωτοβυζαντινή εποχή ως ονομασία ιερέων και άγριων

data.cultural_impact: The name Abroms holds significant cultural weight as a derivative of Abraham, a prominent figure in Judeo-Christian tradition. Abraham is regarded as the founding father of the Jewish people, and is revered in Christianity as an important figure of faith, having demonstrated obedience to God throughout his life. As such, the name Abroms may carry a sense of history, heritage, and strong faith, especially within Judeo-Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Abroms bears spiritual resonance, linked to its Hebrew origins in the name of Father Abraham. In Christianity, Abraham is recognized as a model of faith, given his willingness to leave his homeland and follow God's call, trusting in the divine promise. The name Abroms may inspire a reflection of unwavering faith, obedience, and trust in the divine plan while also representing the deep-rooted and enduring connection between individuals and their belief in a higher power.
